A proper welcome for new listeners, and a few hints for everyone.

## New

- **A first-time welcome.** The first time you open ForYou Music, the logo comes to life, and a few short steps help you get started: what the app promises you, adding your music folder, and meeting Yoru. You can skip adding music and do it later in Settings > Storage.
- **Our promise, up front.** No account, no ads, nothing tracked, and your files are never changed. You also choose right away whether ForYou Music may check GitHub for updates, its only connection to the internet.
- **Helpful hints.** A short tip shows once when you first open the player and when you first browse your songs.

## Improved

- **Permissions are asked when they make sense.** Access to your music is asked when you add a folder, and Android asks about notifications only if you keep Messages from Yoru on.
- **No update check before you're set up.** On a new install, ForYou Music waits until the welcome is done before it contacts GitHub.

## Good to know

- **Already using ForYou Music?** Nothing changes for you: the welcome only shows on a new install, and your greeting still appears when you open the app.
